UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities

Canada ratified the CRPD in 2010, promising to protect the inherent dignity and right to life of every person with a disability. The UN Committee that monitors that treaty has since issued formal warnings. Multiple UN Special Rapporteurs have raised alarms. Health Canada's own annual reports document the expansion.
